newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq hopes to resume oil sales on Wednesday-papers.
newsitem.headline: Iraq hopes to resume oil sales on Wednesday-papers.

text.p: Iraq expects to resume oil exports under its oil-for-food deal with the United Nations on Wednesday, Iraqi newspapers said.

''It is hoped that the first shipments of Iraqi oil for the second six months (period) will start today (Wednesday),'' Iraq's ruling Baath party newspaper al-Thawra said, quoting an Iraqi oil source. Similar reports appeared in other official dailies.
Al-Thawra said a tanker would be loaded with Iraqi crude from the Turkish port of Ceyhan on Wednesday.
The United Nations approved on Tuesday a number of oil contracts Iraq had submitted to the world body under the oil pact which allows Iraq to sell $2 billion worth of oil over six months.
The oil-for-food deal went into effect last December and was renewed for another six months in June but Iraq delayed exports for the second phase to modify the plans for aid.
